Tonight I celebrated my son’s graduation!

My friend & Co-Chair gave his all in Kentucky!

Trump is my President!

Jesus is Lord!

I look forward to a lifetime filled with joy, purpose, and gratitude. May God continue to bless America and the freedoms that make this nation the greatest. 🇺🇸

Massie’s race is fueled by the Constitution and SMALL dollar, grassroots donors!! 

massiemoneybomb.com/

Some dude is reminding me of this post by my friend & 2A Caucus Co-Chair from 2021. 

I was in the House Chambers, FURIOUS, because I had decided to follow Pelosi’s rules to not carry my licensed firearm in that particular part of the Capitol that day. 

Pelosi was removed before any of us knew of any potential threats. She had her security and we were left in the dark.

None of us knew what was happening outside those doors, but we certainly knew it wasn’t MAGA. 
I was DISARMED at that time. No

Yes, I saw the President’s post. 

No, I’m not mad or offended. I knew the risks when I agreed to stand by my friend Thomas Massie. 

I was, and will be, America First, America Always, and MAGA. 

Onward 🇺🇸

These allegations are vile and indefensible. I pray to God there are not real victims out there. I am angry and disgusted. 

Hunter Rivera’s position as Weld County Chair must be replaced immediately.

We have zero tolerance in the Republican Party for anyone involved in these horrific crimes against children. The Weld County GOP needs to act right now to remove him and send a clear message: our party protects kids and upholds integrity. No excuses. No delays. 

Thank you to Larimer County Sheri

Govenor Polis and I have had many conversations regarding Tina’s unjust punishment and her release. 

My heart was filled with joy when he called me today to share this great news!


Nick Sortor (@nicksortor)

The governor’s a Democrat. That’s what took so long.

But @RepBoebert has been pushing Polis HARD in the background to do it.

Can’t thank her enough for that.



— https://nitter.net/nicksortor/status/2055394361748124154#m

Below is my friend Thomas Massie. He loves America and is fighting to save it. 

Also below is my friend and President, Donald Trump. He’s put his life on the line to save this great country. 

I support both of these men. I’ve worked with both to preserve freedom and liberty. 

And if that makes you angry, bless your heart.

At every @chiproytx event I attended in Texas this week,  staff kept giving the “we’re through” signal to stay on schedule.

But in true Chip Roy fashion, he stayed and answered every single question.

This is the kind of representation Texas needs! Vote Chip Roy!


Chip Roy (@chiproytx)
